analysis.title: DeskTalk - US rate check: 5% no more
key_insights: US Treasuries are rallying sharply. 10y yields are about 15bps lower and below 5.00% for the first time in nearly a month as the tech selloff deepens and fiscal fears fade.
Oil is trading near this year's high, yet a rise in longer-term inflation expectations has failed to sustain. Citi reads the market as repricing growth and real rates rather than inflation.
Citi's David Bieber says structural shorts are at risk of a squeeze above 106-00 in TY futures. 10s are trading at 106-10, above that level.
Flow is skewed toward upside duration exposure, with call buying in the belly and call skew flipping bullish.
Traders have pared back October and December FOMC bets. Less than 20bps of cuts or hikes is priced through the remainder of the year.

Inflation strategist Ben Wiltshire says higher nominal yields since Q3 reflect a repricing of the real cost of capital rather than inflation. Breakevens and inflation forwards stayed subdued, so real yields traded as leveraged nominals.
Wiltshire expects future rate rallies to be driven by lower real yields rather than lower inflation expectations as credit cracks emerge and AI optimism fades at the margin.

Because inflation is still above target and it is uncertain whether duration can sustain a rally, Wiltshire sees options on real-vs-nominal yield spreads as the cleaner expression, with attractive asymmetric upside.

The Citi US Rates Strategy desk (Oct 20) is tactically neutral on duration, with rates flip-flopping between AI slowdown concerns and rising energy costs. The desk expresses a long duration bias by receiving October OIS, expecting a pause at the next FOMC.
FI CTA levels to watch into the close cover nearly every tenor. A close above the listed levels would suggest a shift in systematic exposure into Friday.

tension_points.bull_case: Positioning still has room to run: structural shorts face a squeeze above 106-00 in TY, call buying is concentrated in the belly, call skew has flipped bullish, and fewer Fed moves are priced.
tension_points.bear_case: Inflation is still above target, which creates uncertainty over whether duration can sustain a rally. The Rates Strategy desk stays tactically neutral as rates flip-flop between AI slowdown concerns and rising energy costs.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A TY futures move back below 106-00 would remove the short-squeeze setup.
